profile: Native InnoDB with the registered signed field definitions, default physical options and all exact DB settings inherited from the MySQL profile.

finite.admission: Typed native calibrations on five releases. The declared intermediate-profile mapping is checked against the actual engine during every run.

oracle.structural: Build the expected exact action values from independent case coordinates, explicit key roles and ordered native allocation rules.
oracle.native: Run the separately specified original SQL and each rendered SQL on independently rebuilt identical native data. Compare fully typed initial and final metadata, rows, ordered runtime diagnostics, setup and follow-up mutation effects.
oracle.normalization: Only the temporary COPY object name in exact legacy error 1025 is a local server-assigned coordinate. Record and compare all other diagnostic fields, including order and target owner. Keep original raw observer payloads.

Schema/ForeignKey/Exchange/AlterForeignK.role: An atomic ordered change including distinct original physical index drops and new foreign constraints.
Schema/ForeignKey/Exchange/AlterForeignK.structure: Exact absolute owner, ordered native actions, automatically superseded indexes, release and physical options.
Schema/ForeignKey/Exchange/AlterForeignK.meaning: Publish effective explicit and implicit key changes while keeping every retained index requirement and new original/final foreign-key stage.
Schema/ForeignKey/Exchange/AlterForeignK.conditions: Both public routes check the original target and complete retained reference layout before producing the ordered index identity projection. Each supplied retained side must identify its checked original constraint; every known outgoing retained symbol needs its child side.
Schema/ForeignKey/Exchange/AlterForeignK.sql: Render each action in original order, including the exact resolved physical drop. Use the checked absolute owner and original requested options.

Schema/Index/IndexIdentity.role: The exact physical key explicitly removed.
Schema/Index/IndexIdentity.structure: Resolved owner, native physical key name and original effective role.
Schema/Index/IndexIdentity.meaning: Remove the selected physical key, allowing explicit reuse of its native name by a new physical key.
Schema/Index/IndexIdentity.conditions: The key must belong to the exact unchanged initial layout at the atomic removal boundary.
Schema/Index/IndexIdentity.sql: Use the exact physical name in the DROP INDEX position.

faults: Render an index on the wrong self-referenced parent column.
